happy.label: Happy
happy.definition: Things are going well right now, and you feel good about it.

joy.label: Joy
joy.definition: You're filled with a strong, bright happiness.

delighted.label: Delighted
delighted.definition: Something good just happened, and you feel very happy.

elated.label: Elated
elated.definition: Your joy is so big you feel lifted off the ground.

cheerful.label: Cheerful
cheerful.definition: You're in a light, upbeat mood.

playful.label: Playful
playful.definition: You're in the mood to joke around and have fun.

excited.label: Excited
excited.definition: You feel happy and full of energy.

thrilled.label: Thrilled
thrilled.definition: Great news came, or something great is ahead, and you feel excited.

exhilarated.label: Exhilarated
exhilarated.definition: Something you're doing right now gives you a rush of excitement.

proud.label: Proud
proud.definition: You're happy about something you or someone close to you did, or about how others see you.

accomplished.label: Accomplished
accomplished.definition: You finished something hard, and you feel proud.

triumphant.label: Triumphant
triumphant.definition: You won or beat what stood in your way, and you feel proud.

flattered.label: Flattered
flattered.definition: Someone's praise or interest pleases you, and you feel a little proud.

confident.label: Confident
confident.definition: You feel sure you can handle what's in front of you.

brave.label: Brave
brave.definition: You feel sure enough of yourself to face something that frightens you.

empowered.label: Empowered
empowered.definition: Something gave you the power to act, and you feel confident you can make a difference.

powerful.label: Powerful
powerful.definition: You feel strong and in charge.

satisfied.label: Satisfied
satisfied.definition: What you wanted or needed has been met.

fulfilled.label: Fulfilled
fulfilled.definition: What you're doing feels meaningful, and that satisfies you deep down.

content.label: Content
content.definition: You're at ease with what you have and want nothing more.

calm.label: Calm
calm.definition: You feel settled and steady inside.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.definition: You feel loose and unhurried, with your guard down.

safe.label: Safe
safe.definition: Nothing can harm you here, and you feel calm.

relieved.label: Relieved
relieved.definition: A worry or danger passed, and you feel lighter.

reassured.label: Reassured
reassured.definition: Someone or something eased your worry, and you feel relieved.

forgiven.label: Forgiven
forgiven.definition: Someone let go of your mistake, and you feel relieved.

vindicated.label: Vindicated
vindicated.definition: You were doubted and proven right, and you feel relieved.

hopeful.label: Hopeful
hopeful.definition: You believe something good may happen.

optimistic.label: Optimistic
optimistic.definition: You expect things to turn out well.

encouraged.label: Encouraged
encouraged.definition: A good sign came along, and you feel hopeful about going on.

inspired.label: Inspired
inspired.definition: Someone or something showed you what's possible, and you feel motivated.

determined.label: Determined
determined.definition: You're set on getting something done, whatever it takes.

fascinated.label: Fascinated
fascinated.definition: Something holds your attention so fully you can't look away.

amazed.label: Amazed
amazed.definition: Something you didn't expect or think possible happened, and it delights you.

awe.label: Awe
awe.definition: Something vast or beautiful leaves you amazed.

impressed.label: Impressed
impressed.definition: Someone did better than you expected, and you feel amazed.

grateful.label: Grateful
grateful.definition: Someone did or gave you something good, and you feel thankful.

honored.label: Honored
honored.definition: Someone chose or recognized you, and you feel grateful.

blessed.label: Blessed
blessed.definition: You have good things in your life that no one in particular gave you, and you feel grateful.

love.label: Love
love.definition: You feel warmth toward someone and want to be close to them.

affection.label: Affection
affection.definition: You feel a warm fondness for someone.

tenderness.label: Tenderness
tenderness.definition: You feel a soft, gentle affection for someone.

protective.label: Protective
protective.definition: You want to keep someone you love from harm.

cared-for.label: Cared for
cared-for.definition: Someone looks after you with care, and you feel their affection.

compassion.label: Compassion
compassion.definition: You feel for someone who's suffering, and you want to help.

sympathy.label: Sympathy
sympathy.definition: You're with someone in their pain, and you want to comfort them.

moved.label: Moved
moved.definition: Someone's suffering or courage stirred you, maybe to tears, and you feel for them.

connected.label: Connected
connected.definition: You feel close to someone, or part of something.

understood.label: Understood
understood.definition: Someone really gets you, and you feel connected.

valued.label: Valued
valued.definition: Others show you matter, and you feel connected.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.definition: Others welcomed you as you are, and you feel connected.

desire.label: Desire
desire.definition: You want someone, romantically or physically.

aroused.label: Aroused
aroused.definition: You feel sexually stirred by someone.

sad.label: Sad
sad.definition: You feel low and heavy, often after a loss.

lonely.label: Lonely
lonely.definition: You want company or closeness that you don't have.

left-out.label: Left out
left-out.definition: You weren't included, maybe by accident, and you feel lonely.

misunderstood.label: Misunderstood
misunderstood.definition: Others don't get you, and you feel lonely.

abandoned.label: Abandoned
abandoned.definition: Someone you counted on left, and you feel lonely.

hurt.label: Hurt

betrayed.label: Betrayed

rejected.label: Rejected

unappreciated.label: Unappreciated
unappreciated.definition: What you do goes unnoticed, and you feel hurt.

disappointed.label: Disappointed
disappointed.definition: Things didn't turn out as you hoped, and you feel deflated.

discouraged.label: Discouraged
discouraged.definition: Setbacks have worn you down, and you feel like giving up.

regret.label: Regret

disillusioned.label: Disillusioned

grief.label: Grief
grief.definition: You lost someone or something, and you feel deep sorrow.

heartbroken.label: Heartbroken
heartbroken.definition: A love or a close bond ended, and you feel deep grief.

devastated.label: Devastated
devastated.definition: A huge loss knocked you flat, and you feel deep grief.

empty.label: Empty

heartache.label: Heartache
heartache.definition: Your heart aches for someone or something out of reach, or for someone who's suffering.

homesick.label: Homesick

nostalgic.label: Nostalgic
nostalgic.definition: You think of times gone by with a wistful ache, often mixed with warmth.

sorry-for-someone.label: Sorry for someone
sorry-for-someone.definition: Someone else's pain saddens you, even from a distance.

down.label: Down
down.definition: You feel sad and drained, with little energy for anything.

hopeless.label: Hopeless
hopeless.definition: You can't see things getting better.

miserable.label: Miserable
miserable.definition: You feel so down that everything seems awful.

defeated.label: Defeated
defeated.definition: You lost or failed, and you feel beaten.

ashamed.label: Ashamed

humiliated.label: Humiliated

inadequate.label: Inadequate

inferior.label: Inferior

insignificant.label: Insignificant

scared.label: Scared

anxious.label: Anxious

dread.label: Dread

suspicious.label: Suspicious

nervous.label: Nervous

insecure.label: Insecure

uneasy.label: Uneasy

panicked.label: Panicked

petrified.label: Petrified
petrified.definition: You're so scared you can't move.

horrified.label: Horrified

helpless.label: Helpless

threatened.label: Threatened
threatened.definition: Someone or something could harm you, and you feel vulnerable.

angry.label: Angry
angry.definition: Something's unfair or in your way, and you want to push back.

annoyed.label: Annoyed
annoyed.definition: Something bothered you, and you feel mildly angry.

irritable.label: Irritable
irritable.definition: Everything is getting on your nerves right now.

impatient.label: Impatient
impatient.definition: You're kept waiting, and you feel annoyed.

provoked.label: Provoked
provoked.definition: Someone deliberately pushed your buttons, and you feel annoyed.

frustrated.label: Frustrated

outraged.label: Outraged
outraged.definition: Something wrong or unjust happened, and you feel furious.

rage.label: Rage
rage.definition: Your anger is so strong you might lose control.

violated.label: Violated
violated.definition: Someone crossed a line with you they had no right to cross, and you feel furious.

resentful.label: Resentful
resentful.definition: You were treated unfairly, and you feel anger that lingers.

cheated.label: Cheated
cheated.definition: Someone took what was fairly yours, and you feel resentful.

used.label: Used

insulted.label: Insulted
insulted.definition: Someone said something to put you down, and you feel offended.

indignant.label: Indignant

jealous.label: Jealous

disgusted.label: Disgusted
disgusted.definition: Someone did something cruel or wrong, and you can't stand it.

appalled.label: Appalled
appalled.definition: You can't believe how cruel or wrong something was, and you feel disgusted.

contempt.label: Contempt
contempt.definition: You look down on someone, with a cold disgust.

hatred.label: Hatred
hatred.definition: You can't stand who someone is, not just what they did, and it lasts.

bad.label: Bad
bad.definition: You feel off or out of sorts, whether or not you can say why.

bored.label: Bored
bored.definition: Nothing holds your attention, and time drags.

restless.label: Restless
restless.definition: You're bored and can't sit still.

unmotivated.label: Unmotivated
unmotivated.definition: You have no drive to start anything.

overwhelmed.label: Overwhelmed
overwhelmed.definition: Too much is coming at you, and you feel you can't cope.

pressured.label: Pressured
pressured.definition: Others push you harder than you can go, and you feel overwhelmed.

burned-out.label: Burned out

confused.label: Confused
confused.definition: Things don't make sense to you.

conflicted.label: Conflicted

lost.label: Lost
lost.definition: You don't know which way to go from here.

numb.label: Numb
numb.definition: You can't feel much of anything.

disconnected.label: Disconnected
disconnected.definition: You feel cut off from yourself or what's around you.

uncomfortable.label: Uncomfortable
uncomfortable.definition: You feel ill at ease in a place or with the people around you.

awkward.label: Awkward
awkward.definition: You're unsure how to act around others.

embarrassed.label: Embarrassed
embarrassed.definition: Something silly happened in front of others, and you wish no one had seen it.

foolish.label: Foolish
foolish.definition: You made a silly mistake, and you feel embarrassed.

mortified.label: Mortified
mortified.definition: You're so embarrassed you want to vanish.

cringe.label: Cringe
cringe.definition: You see someone do something embarrassing, or remember something you did, and you wince with embarrassment.

guilty.label: Guilty
guilty.definition: You feel bad about something you did.

remorse.label: Remorse
remorse.definition: You feel deep guilt and wish you hadn't caused harm.

apologetic.label: Apologetic
apologetic.definition: You feel guilty and want to make amends.

physically-disgusted.label: Disgusted
physically-disgusted.definition: Something gross, like a smell or something slimy, makes you want to pull away.

repulsed.label: Repulsed
repulsed.definition: You're so disgusted by something that you have to get away from it.

squeamish.label: Squeamish
squeamish.definition: Blood, injury, or bugs make your stomach turn.

about.heading: Feels on Wheels
about.summary: A free feelings wheel and body sensations wheel, to help you find the word for what you feel.

sections.heading: What it's for
body: Naming a feeling precisely helps you understand it, and helps you tell other people about it. A feelings wheel starts from a few core feelings in the middle and gets more specific toward the edge.
The body sensations wheel works the other way in. It starts from what you notice in your body, like a racing heart or clenched teeth, and leads to the feelings that often come with it.

sections.heading: How to use it
body: Tap or click a feeling to narrow it down, and spin the wheel to see more. Open a word to read what it means and what you might notice in your body.
Switch between the two wheels at the top. Everything works with a keyboard, and it's built for screen readers. [Read about its accessibility]({accessibility}).

sections.heading: Install it
body: To keep it handy, install it from your browser's menu, or use Add to Home Screen on an iPhone or iPad.

sections.heading: Why it exists
body: I always had trouble identifying my emotions. For much of my life they only came out as anger, or I couldn't feel very much at all. Through therapy, journaling, and checking in with myself daily, I came to lean on a feelings wheel to sort out the words for my deeper feelings.
I wanted to make a version that's accessible, beautiful, fast, and versatile, for anyone else who needs help finding the words for how they feel. I hope it helps.

sections.heading: Credits
body: This app builds on feelings wheels by Gloria Willcox, Geoffrey Roberts, and Lindsay Braman, and on feelingswheel.com. The body sensations wheel also draws on research into where people feel emotions and what feelings pull them to do. Its definitions and sensations are written in its own words.
It was put together by someone without formal training in psychology, and it isn't a clinical tool.
[Read the full credits and the research behind the body wheel]({credits}).
[Think a word or definition is wrong? Tell us]({issues}).

sections.heading: Help translate
body: Would you like Feels on Wheels in your language? A language is one file of words. [Here's how to help]({contributing}).
